title: myosotis sylvatica subsp. teresiana
intro: Myosotis sylvatica subsp. teresiana, commonly known as alpine forget-me-not, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of M. sylvatica subsp. teresiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its potential in alleviating symptoms associated with infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
